statement: Twisted SMC showed a strong developmental efficacy signal and earned scaling. On the deterministic 16-source probe at MATCHED four-slot budget it increased source coverage from 4/16 under rejection-h_phi to 11/16, solving seven sources rejection did not and losing none.
not_a_claim: This is a DEVELOPMENT GATE, not the official efficacy experiment. Do not call it a statistically definitive benchmark win. The 16-source subset is easier than panel average (that is why only matched baselines on these same sources are used). 60.9% of slots still went extinct — success is heterogeneous across sources.

mechanical_qualification.note: absorption check was fixed to be epoch-aware: resampling permutes particle indices, so index identity holds only within an epoch. The reference run had zero resamples so the flaw was invisible there.

mechanism.contrast_with_reference: reference: 0/32 absorbed, 0 resamples, min ESS 20.8. The SMC machinery simply never engaged on that single source.

next: Build particle-level process parallelism. Do NOT change N=32, weights, ESS threshold, resampler, output rule, extinction rule, R_theta or h_phi. Qualify by EXACT same-seed parity, then run all 64 development sources at four slots before considering 128x20.
